description: Defines PII detection rules for the NLQ agent's schema masking layer. 'pii_keywords' are matched against column names (case-insensitive substring match) to flag PII columns before schema info is passed to the LLM. 'pii_patterns' are regex patterns applied to data values to catch PII that may surface in query results or agent responses.

pii_patterns.name: us_phone
pii_patterns.description: US phone numbers in common formats.

pii_patterns.name: ssn
pii_patterns.description: US Social Security Number in canonical hyphenated format.

pii_patterns.name: credit_card
pii_patterns.description: Major card network formats, optionally space- or hyphen-delimited.
